en.name: Mozzarella, fresh in brine
en.summary: Fresh mozzarella is an unripened stretched-curd cheese sold swimming in its own lightly salted liquid. No authority publishes a shelf life for it, so treat it like cottage cheese, the nearest fresh unripened curd with a published figure: about two weeks from purchase unopened, and five to seven days once the tub is open.
en.pantry: Fresh mozzarella is high-moisture, low-acid and only lightly salted, which is the profile Listeria monocytogenes does best on — and that organism grows slowly even at 0 °C, so there is no version of leaving it out that is a good idea. Take it from the fridge 20–30 minutes before serving for flavour, then put it away. The two-hour rule applies, one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Keep it in its sealed tub at 0–5 °C, to the printed date, and treat about two weeks from purchase as a working limit — a figure borrowed from cottage cheese rather than published for mozzarella. The liquid is not packing waste: it is lightly salted whey that keeps the curd hydrated and holds a salt concentration at the surface where contamination would otherwise settle, so do not pour it away until you are ready to eat. Once opened, keep the ball fully submerged in a sealed tub, topping up with lightly salted water if you have lost some, and finish it within about five to seven days. Never store it in plain water, which leaches salt out of the curd and leaves a sweeter, wetter, less protected cheese. Mozzarella di bufala campana is often made from raw milk; if you are pregnant or immunocompromised, check the label or cook it.
en.freezer: Freeze it only if you are going to cook it. Drain the ball, blot it dry, wrap it airtight and freeze it as a block at −18 °C (0 °F); a month or two is a sensible working limit for quality rather than a documented one. Thawed fresh mozzarella weeps badly and turns squeaky, which is invisible under a pizza and unforgivable in a caprese. Grate it while still part-frozen — it is far easier that way.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight and use it the same day, grated or torn onto something that is going into the oven. Never thaw it on the counter or in water, and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: Liquid gone cloudy, thick, ropy or stringy when you tip the tub
A sour, yeasty or sharply fermented smell instead of a clean milky one
A slimy or sticky surface on the ball, or yellowing skin
A bulging lid on an unopened tub, or any mould at all
tips: Buy the size you will finish; a big ball opened for one salad rarely lasts the week.
Keep the liquid — it is the storage medium, not waste.
If you have lost liquid, top up with lightly salted water, never plain water.
Drain and blot for 15 minutes before it goes on a pizza, or the base will be soggy.

faq.q: How long does fresh mozzarella last in the fridge?
faq.a: There is no published figure. Follow the printed date, and treat about two weeks from purchase unopened and five to seven days after opening as working limits, borrowed from cottage cheese.
You can, but only for cooking. Drain, blot and freeze it as a block at −18 °C (0 °F); a month or two is a reasonable quality limit. It thaws wet and squeaky.

faq.q: Should you keep mozzarella in its liquid?
faq.a: Yes. The lightly salted whey keeps the curd hydrated and protects the surface. Store the ball submerged and only drain it when you are about to eat it.

faq.q: Can you eat fresh mozzarella when pregnant?
faq.a: Advice for vulnerable groups is to avoid soft and semi-soft cheeses unless thoroughly cooked, and that covers pasteurised ones as well as raw-milk ones. Cooked on a pizza it is a different proposition from torn raw over a salad.

zh.name: 新鮮莫札瑞拉（鹽水浸漬）
zh.summary: 新鮮莫札瑞拉是不經熟成的拉絲凝乳起司，泡在自己的淡鹽乳清裡販售。沒有權威單位公布它的保存期限，所以可以比照茅屋起司（cottage cheese）來看——那是最接近的新鮮未熟成凝乳、而且有公布數字：未開封從購買日起約兩週，開封後約五到七天。
zh.pantry: 新鮮莫札瑞拉含水量高、酸度低、鹽分也只有一點點，正是李斯特菌最能發揮的條件；而這種菌即使在 0°C 都還能緩慢生長，所以沒有任何「放外面一下」是合理的。為了風味，可以在上桌前 20～30 分鐘從冰箱拿出來，吃完立刻收回去。兩小時原則同樣適用，氣溫超過 32°C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 未開封請連盒放在 0～5°C 冷藏，以包裝上的日期為準，並把「從購買日起約兩週」當成工作上的參考上限——這個數字是比照茅屋起司而來，不是針對莫札瑞拉公布的。盒裡的水不是要倒掉的包裝液：那是淡鹽乳清，能維持凝乳的含水度，也在表面維持一定鹽度，讓污染不易著床，所以要吃之前才瀝掉。開封後請把起司球完全浸在液體裡、密封冷藏，水不夠就補一點淡鹽水，並在五到七天內吃完。千萬不要泡在純清水裡，那會把凝乳裡的鹽分溶出，留下一塊更甜、更濕、也更沒有防護的起司。此外，水牛莫札瑞拉常以生乳製作；孕婦或免疫力較弱者請確認標示，或加熱後再吃。
zh.freezer: 只有打算拿來煮才冷凍。把球瀝乾、擦乾水分，密封包好整塊放 −18°C；品質上以一兩個月為合理參考，而不是有依據的數字。解凍後的新鮮莫札瑞拉會大量出水、口感變得吱吱作響，這在披薩底下看不出來，但用在卡布里沙拉上就毀了。趁半解凍時刨絲會輕鬆很多。
zh.thawing: 解凍請放冷藏室退冰一晚，並當天用完，刨絲或撕塊鋪在要進烤箱的料理上。不要在室溫解凍，也不要泡水解凍，更不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 倒盒子時發現液體混濁、變稠、牽絲
聞起來酸、有酵母味或明顯發酵味，而不是乾淨的奶味
起司球表面黏手，或外層泛黃
未開封的盒蓋鼓起，或看到任何黴點
tips: 買吃得完的尺寸；為了一份沙拉開一顆大球，通常撐不到週末。
液體要留著，那是保存介質不是廢水。
液體不夠時補淡鹽水，絕對不要補純清水。
要放上披薩前先瀝乾、用紙巾壓 15 分鐘，否則餅皮一定濕軟。

faq.q: 新鮮莫札瑞拉放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有公布的數字。請以包裝上的日期為準，並把未開封約兩週、開封後五到七天當作參考上限，這是比照茅屋起司而來的。

faq.q: 新鮮莫札瑞拉可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，但只建議用於烹調。瀝乾擦乾後整塊密封放 −18°C，品質以一兩個月為合理參考。解凍後會出水、口感變得吱吱的。

faq.q: 莫札瑞拉一定要泡在水裡嗎？
faq.a: 要。那層淡鹽乳清能維持凝乳含水度並保護表面。請讓起司球完全浸沒，要吃之前才瀝掉。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃新鮮莫札瑞拉嗎？
faq.a: 針對高風險族群的建議是：除非徹底加熱，否則避開軟質與半軟質起司，殺菌乳製的也一樣。烤在披薩上和撕碎生拌沙拉，是完全不同的兩件事。
